## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`AGENTS.md` still tells contributors to run `make test`, but this pull request removes that target, so the only pre-push test step in the guide now fails. This is an Important fix, and it should land with the rename.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README's command to match. It also adds a Layout section to `AGENTS.md` that lists each repository file and the Makefile targets.

## Important
- AGENTS.md:23 — comments — Update the Commands entry to `make check` — Line 23 still says "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." The rename in `Makefile:6` (`check:`) means `make test` now fails with "No rule to make target 'test'". It also contradicts the new line 15, "`Makefile` defines the `check` and `lint` targets." — Line 25 says the repository has no CI, so anyone who follows the guide gets a make error and no test run before pushing.
